Sports Card & Pokémon Show

Description
Calling all sports card collectors and Pokémon enthusiasts! Join Larson RED ZONE Sports for a three-day Sports Card & Pokémon Show, featuring a variety of sports cards, memorabilia, Pokémon, TCG Products, and more for collectors of all ages. Whether you're a seasoned collector looking to add to your collection or just getting started, this family-friendly event offers something for everyone! The show will take place Friday, November 6th, from 3–6 PM; Saturday, November 7th, from 11 AM–6 PM; and Sunday, November 8th, from 11 AM–3 PM. For more information, visit https://www.facebook.com/LarsonRedZone.

Larson Red Zone Sports
